owner_verdict: V3.1 REJECTED: interior imagery and stretched photo projections are visible in the outdoor scene.
objective: Rebuild the local visual layer from outdoor AUMARA media only, using genuine multi-view geometry where available. Do not use visible photo cards as scene geometry.

sources.rule: INTERIOR, DETAIL and REJECT files must never be used by the outdoor visible scene. Produce AUMARA_V3_2_MEDIA_CLASSIFICATION.json.

reconstruction: Extract sharp overlapping outdoor keyframes from video.
Group images by path corridor and house neighborhood.
Run a real multi-view pose/depth reconstruction. Prefer MASt3R if COLMAP/OpenMVG are unavailable; DUSt3R is an acceptable fallback.
Fuse solved outdoor geometry into local ENU and align to canonical georeference/plan constraints.
Reject floaters and regions unsupported by multiple views.
Use V2.1 only as hidden collision/alignment scaffold.
Near-path ground must come from outdoor source imagery; PNOA is distant context only.
Near vegetation must come from outdoor source reconstruction or source-derived alpha/splat representation.
engine_failure_rule: If genuine multi-view reconstruction cannot execute, return BLOCKED_RECON_ENGINE with a clean outdoor source pack and command pack. Do not substitute photo posters or generic procedural scenery.
pass_bar: at least one house reads as spatial exterior geometry
return: absolute /v3-2-proof URL + reconstruction status + short stats only
